main_text.p: 4. Pro interrogativo τίς quis. Lucian. τοῦ Ἔμπα δ' ἀνήλλαγη[?]; quomodo verò immutata est? Item, τοῦ τῶτο ἔχος τε-κμαίρεσθαι[?]; quo id potes conjicere?
5. Pro infinito τινὸς, τινί. Xenoph. ὤν τε τοῦ τι ὑπισχνουμένου, & si cui quid polli-centur. Soph. εἰ φόβος τὸ γλῶσαν ἐγκλεί-σας ἔχει, si metus alicujus gratia lin-guam inclusam habeat.
6. Pro τοσούτῳ tanto. Iliad. θ, τοῦ χρειόντων μὴ Ζεὺς πολεμοῦ ἀλιμυ-ρηέντων,

p.i: Tantò præstantior est quidem Jupiter fluviis in mare fluentibus.

main_text.p: Articulus aliquando redundat. Lucian. κελεύει δὲ ὁ Ζεὺς δικάσαι τῆς θεᾶς, ἥτις αὐτῶν ἡ κάλλιστη, jubet te Jupiter ju-dicare deabus, quænam ipsarum pul-cherrima sit.

page.notes: Greek text is only approximately legible in the scan; accents and some letters are doubtful and marked [?]. The signature reads "u iiij" in the scan, with the last numeral partly faded. No catchword is clearly printed. Scan has heavy staining at the edges, no marginal notes.
